defaults.description: Applied to every database that does not override the field.

host.description: Postgres host written to the secret. Defaults to cloudnative-pg-cluster-rw.cnpg-system.

port.description: Postgres port written to the secret. Defaults to 5432.

resyncInterval.description: Seconds between credential refreshes. Defaults to 300.

databases.description: One OpenBao-backed credentials secret per entry. The database and role themselves are defined in system-components/postgres-cluster.

namespace.description: Namespace the generator, ExternalSecret and secret are created in. Defaults to the release namespace.

annotations.description: Annotations set on the generator, ExternalSecret and secret.

name.description: OpenBao static role name; credentials are read from database/static-creds/<name> using kubernetes auth role db-<name>.

databaseName.description: Postgres database name written to PGDATABASE and DATABASE_URL. Defaults to name with dashes replaced by underscores.

secretName.description: Secret holding the connection details. Defaults to <name>-database-secret.
